headline: Harsh Patel and Saket Poswal make major ARC-3 climbs

sections.text: Harsh Patel gained 10.14 points to reach 33.87, moving from 1,361st to 46th. Saket Poswal added 7.25 to reach 33.94 and rose from 1,110th to 44th.
They now sit 46th and 44th, respectively, on a board led by Tufa Labs at 68.91.
